5. Check-ins and notifications: You can manually check in at specific locations to let your family members know you have arrived safely. Life360 also allows for sending notifications and messages within the app.

6. Battery level: Life360 may have access to the battery level of the Lenovo ThinkPhone devices connected to the app. This information can be used to provide alerts when a family member’s device is low on battery.

It’s important to note that while Life360 is designed to facilitate family communication and safety, the extent of data visibility and tracking can vary based on the settings and permissions configured within the app.

Part 1: What Does “Location Not Available” Mean on Find My Friends?

When the “Location Not Available” message appears on Find My Friends, it means that you have disabled location sharing or have turned off your device’s location services. In some cases, the message can indicate that you have logged out of your iCloud account or that there is an issue with the iCloud server.

Not! This message does not necessarily mean that you have blocked yourself or there is something wrong with your device. If you frequently see the “Location Not Available” message, you may need to check your own device’s settings or contact your friends to confirm their location-sharing preferences.

How to distinguish “No Location Found” and “Location Not Available”?

“No Location Found” means that the Find My app is unable to locate the Nokia C110 device being tracked. This can happen for a variety of reasons, such as if the Nokia C110 device is turned off, not connected to the internet, or if location services are disabled.

“Location Not Available” means that the Nokia C110 device is not currently sharing its location with the Find My app. This can happen if the Nokia C110 device is in Airplane mode or if the user has turned off location sharing for the Find My app. It can also happen if there is a temporary issue with the iCloud servers.

In summary, “No Location Found” means the app could not locate the Nokia C110 device, while “Location Not Available” means that the Nokia C110 device is not currently sharing its location.
